title: Constant-Behavior XOR-Cipher HLS Kernel: Eliminating Key-Dependent Status/Iteration Leakage
expected_output_summary: A hardened inputs/crypto_kernel.c that compiles cleanly standalone with both gcc and g++ using only <stdint.h> and <string.h>, preserves the exact pinned signature `void crypto_kernel(const uint8_t plaintext[HLS_BLOCK_SIZE], const uint8_t key[HLS_BLOCK_SIZE], uint8_t ciphertext[HLS_BLOCK_SIZE], int *status_out, unsigned int *iter_count_out)` with HLS_BLOCK_SIZE=16, and unconditionally executes a fixed 16-iteration loop with no key-dependent branching anywhere. For every (plaintext, key) pair, ciphertext[i] must equal plaintext[i] ^ key[i]. For a fixed plaintext, status_out must be constant across all key values and equal the XOR-fold checksum of the plaintext bytes, and iter_count_out must always equal 16 regardless of key content, eliminating the CWE-208/CWE-203/CWE-385/CWE-200 key-dependent early-exit leakage present in the shipped insecure baseline.

metrics.name: cwe_violation_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the behavioral security test battery (key sweep including edge cases) in which status_out or iter_count_out varies across differing secret keys for a fixed plaintext, indicating a CWE-208/CWE-203/CWE-385/CWE-200 style leakage of key material through a non-declassified channel.

metrics.name: information_flow_correctness
metrics.description: Proportion of test cases in which the only output that legitimately varies with the secret key is ciphertext (matching plaintext XOR key), while status_out and iter_count_out remain invariant and match their plaintext-only reference values.

metrics.name: synthesis_pass_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the full evaluation suite (compilation under gcc/g++, known-answer functional correctness, and the invariance/leakage battery) that passes end-to-end when the submitted inputs/crypto_kernel.c is compiled and run against the generated test harness.
